title: Force Urbania
audience: Room for everyone. Space to travel well.
description: 16-seater Force Urbania service from Varanasi, with pickups and destinations within 300 km, subject to route and vehicle availability.
image_alt: Side profile of the long-wheelbase Force Urbania passenger van
image_note: Long-wheelbase model shown for reference. Interiors vary by configuration.
details: Service operates from Varanasi. Journeys may start in Varanasi and travel to destinations within 300 km; pickups within 300 km of Varanasi are also supported. Airport transfers start at ₹2,999, taxes extra. Tolls, border tax, parking, driver allowance and other trip-specific costs are confirmed in your written quotation before booking. Vehicle configuration and availability are confirmed before booking.
